response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for unstable angina, which is an acute medical condition. Clause A4.1 covers the costs of outpatient care, hospitalization, and prescribed medications if incurred due to an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the condition was pre-existing and not related to the trip, so clause A5.1 does not apply here."}
